proof_body:
by
  intro a b f hf hab
  have h := Real.tendsto_integral_exp_smul_cocompact ((Set.Ioc a b).indicator f)
  have hm : Filter.Tendsto (fun l : ℝ => -(l / (2 * Real.pi))) (Filter.cocompact ℝ) (Filter.cocompact ℝ) := by
    have hc : (-(1 / (2 * Real.pi)) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      have := Real.pi_pos
      simp [this.ne']
    have := Homeomorph.mulRight₀ (-(1 / (2 * Real.pi)) : ℝ) hc |>.isClosedEmbedding.tendsto_cocompact
    refine this.congr (fun l => ?_)
    simp
    ring
  have h2 := h.comp hm
  refine h2.congr (fun l => ?_)
  simp only [Function.comp, Circle.smul_def]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab, ← MeasureTheory.integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioc]
  congr 1
  funext x
  rw [Real.fourierChar_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.Ioc a b
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
    congr 2
    have := Real.pi_pos
    push_cast
    field_simp
  · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
target_source: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℂ), IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume a b → a ≤ b → Filter.Tendsto (fun l : ℝ => ∫ x in a..b, Complex.exp (((l * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * f x) (Filter.cocompact ℝ) (nhds 0)
